negative_results.statement: the guard does NOT fire on pace_gap, pace_evidence_depth, opp_pace_evidence_depth or is_playoff_game
negative_results.caveat: pace_gap measures r = exactly 0.0 against every prohibited quantity. This is a structural artifact of the two-sided design -- the two rows of a game carry exactly negated pace_gap and identical game_minutes, so the covariance cancels by antisymmetry. It must not be cited as an independence result

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a test proves unlagged master_team.minutes FAILS

acceptance_criteria.detail: game_minutes is recovered from minutes/5 by an affine map with slope 1.0 and relative max residual 0.0

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a test proves a renamed or linearly transformed current-game duration FAILS
acceptance_criteria.detail: four variants tested: rename (byte-identical values), affine 3x-17.5, nonlinear injective exp(x/100), and raw game_minutes. The partition test function_of_prohibited is invariant to ANY injective reparameterisation, so it catches all four; the affine tests are cardinality-free and catch the linear case without a partition argument. The nonlinear case defeats affine recovery and is caught by the partition test alone -- neither check is sufficient on its own

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a test proves a correctly lagged prior-game duration PASSES when every cutoff check passes

detail.null_handling: the 15 first-appearance rows are DROPPED, not imputed. Imputing would be an undeclared transformation (GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT section 8a) and would break the lag re-derivation

acceptance_criteria.detail: eight independent routes, all blocking: undeclared column, declared SAME_GAME, same-game values mislabelled PRIOR_GAME, strict_inequality=False, PRIOR_GAME with no source to re-derive from, prohibited basis omitted, prohibited basis misaligned, and guarded_audit raising before feature_gate sees the design

contradictions.severity_basis: RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1 Severity C explicitly lists 'stronger digest binding'
contradictions.statement: construction_receipt RECORDS the lag transformation but does not BIND it. binding_fields binds transformation_digest -- the stored scalar -- and verify_construction_receipt never recomputes sha256(canonical(transformation)) from the transformation body. An emitted receipt's lag declaration can therefore be edited in place and still verify clean
contradictions.why_it_matters: the edited field in the demonstration is strict_inequality, which is exactly the flag separating a lawful prior-game lag from a same-game join
contradictions.resolution: NOT resolved by editing the frozen module. Closed at the CALL SITE by postgame_surrogate_guard.verify_guard_receipt, which delegates to cr.verify_construction_receipt and then recomputes the transformation digest, raising transformation_body_edited
contradictions.stop_condition_reasoning: does not change the primary target, the K0 structure, the inference structure, the candidate universe, the cutoff-valid feature set, or the leakage status

contradictions.statement: GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT.md's stated preparation basis for feature_gate.py (42af2cd, informative missingness) matches the live git log, and the file is clean in git status. feature_gate.BLOCKING has exactly the 12 kinds section 3 enumerates and the thresholds match. No document/bytes disagreement found

contradictions.severity: none -- wording caveat, not a correction
contradictions.statement: S1's consequence says master_team.minutes 'must be named an explicitly PROHIBITED column ... and any lagged use must be audited rather than assumed safe'. The N2 sweep supports the stronger statement that minutes is the ONLY duration surrogate among master_team's 51 numeric columns, so naming it is SUFFICIENT for that artifact against this basis -- and only against this basis

could_not_establish.statement: that the guard catches a non-exact, nonlinear NEAR-surrogate of the form f(game_minutes) + noise, where the noise breaks both partition tests and keeps |r| below 0.999
could_not_establish.why: the battery is an EXACT dependency guard plus one correlation threshold at |r| >= 0.999. I did not construct such a column and did not measure the boundary. This mirrors the open gap GATE_INVOCATION_CONTRACT section 7.1 records for feature_gate.py, one comparand over. It is NOT closed here

could_not_establish.statement: that prior_game_minutes is cutoff-valid in the OPERATIONAL sense, i.e. that the universe-restricted game history equals the true schedule history
could_not_establish.why: the re-derivation proves the column equals the club's previous game WITHIN the audited universe (0 of 2,982 rows disagreeing). The 8 team-games dropped by the pace_resolved restriction and the 4 games in possessions_raw_v2 that are not in the universe are absent from that history. Any arm using this column must state which of the two histories it means

could_not_establish.statement: that the single 8-period game is a real four-overtime game rather than a period-coding artifact
could_not_establish.why: two independent artifacts agree on eight periods, which is strong, but no play-by-play inspection was performed. It affects only the 2-row support of the game_minutes = 60 level

could_not_establish.statement: anything about the other prohibited-outcome surfaces: S3's 5,373 missed_game_* injury rows, S8's 32 unadjudicated possession columns, S2's join hazards
could_not_establish.why: out of this node's mandate. is_overtime is in this guard's basis and is therefore blocked as a feature by construction, but score_diff_offense_start, abs_score_diff_start, non_competitive_conservative and the rest belong to P2A_POSSESSION_COLUMN_ADJUDICATION. A pass from this guard is NOT a cutoff-validity certificate

stop_condition_statement: No finding in this node changes the primary target, the K0 structure, the inference structure, the candidate universe, the cutoff-valid feature set, or the leakage status. S1's leakage status was already declared by the frozen V2 halt packet; this node implements the enforcement S1 asked for and does not re-adjudicate it. The one defect found (C1) is Severity C and is closed at the call site without touching the frozen artifact.

entry_points.LagSpec(...): declare one column's lag transformation and source keys; kinds are SAME_GAME, PRIOR_GAME, SCHEDULE, DERIVED_NO_JOIN
entry_points.audit(frame, names, prohibited=, lag_spe: enforce S1; raises PostgameSurrogateFailure on any blocking finding
entry_points.guarded_audit(...): guard FIRST, then feature_gate.audit; returns both records
entry_points.emit_guard_receipt(...): emit a construction_receipt/1 whose transformation block is the lag record
entry_points.verify_guard_receipt(path, ...): cr.verify_construction_receipt PLUS the transformation-digest recomputation C1 requires

interface_for_downstream_callers.claim_boundary: a pass from this guard establishes ONE invariant: no declared feature is, or recovers, the realised current-game duration. It is a NECESSARY condition, never a sufficient one, and it is not a cutoff-validity certificate
